The NPS Social Science Program is responsible for coordinating visitor use &#13;
statistics reporting for units administered by the NPS. ‘Visitor Use Statistics’ &#13;
refers to a formal set of statistics collected by the National Park Service that &#13;
address how many people visit parks and how long they stay. Program staff work &#13;
with parks to develop appropriate data collection procedures and provide quality &#13;
control for visitor use data. Such coordination ensures that visitor use data &#13;
are consistent and reliable throughout all units of the National Park System. &#13;
This data package contains data collected from 1979-2024.</para>
      <para>Detailed instructions for the units that collect data, monthly visitation &#13;
summaries, and reports displaying trends in park visitation are available on the &#13;
NPS Visitor Use Statistics website (https://irma.nps.gov/Stats/).
